summary.what_it_does: The site is a curated prompt library for Google's Gemini Omni model, which the page describes as an any-to-any multimodal model that takes images, audio, video and text as input and generates videos. It lists 20 prompts across 9 categories, including cinematic continuous shots, aerial reveals, slow-motion physics tests, VFX transitions, product shots, drone and FPV flythroughs. Prompts are adapted from Google's DeepMind prompt guide and community testing, and the page says each cites its sources. It also offers weekly YouTube videos showing prompts run through Gemini Omni output.
notable: Prompts adapted from Google's DeepMind prompt guide and verified community testing, with citations
Weekly video walkthroughs showing actual Gemini Omni output
caveats: Independent and unofficial; not affiliated with Google
Prompt count is small (20 prompts across 9 categories)
